title: Deterministic space is contained in nondeterministic space
statement: For every function $s : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the class of binary languages decidable by finite deterministic Turing machines using space at most a constant multiple of $s(n)$ is contained in the class decidable by finite nondeterministic Turing machines under the corresponding space bound.
